_note: Hours and holidays are hand-compiled and every venue stays verified=false until checked against the exchange. Where the oracle's observed behaviour contradicted the first draft, the hours below follow the observation; each such venue says so in its own note. Observations so far cover 2026-11-26 11:40 UTC to 2026-11-27 11:05 UTC only, a US holiday followed by a half day, so the US pattern in particular needs normal sessions to confirm it. The 'extended' list is also used for a second trading session after a lunch break. Windows cannot cross midnight.

us_equity.note: Observed: closed-like all of Thanksgiving until 20:00 New York, then external-looking without a break through the overnight and pre-market hours. Modelled as open from Sunday 20:00 to Friday 20:00. Whether the overnight session before a holiday trades, and whether normal weekdays have any break, has not been observed.

krx.note: Observed for SKHX, SMSN and HYUNDAI: external from 09:00, internal from about 15:20 to 16:00, external again until 20:00 Seoul time. No pre-market session was seen.

krx_futures.note: Observed for KR200: external 08:45 to about 15:40 and from 18:00 through the night to about 06:00 Seoul time. The night session is split at midnight because windows cannot cross it; Saturday 00:00-06:00 is therefore wrongly treated as closed.

tse_pts.note: Observed for KIOXIA and SOFTBANK: external until about midnight Tokyo time, internal overnight, external again before the cash open, with a short internal spell around 16:30-17:00. The exact session edges are assumed from that pattern.

sse.note: Observed for CXMT, GIGADEV, UNITREE and CAMBRICON: external 09:30-11:30 and 13:00-15:00 China time, internal over lunch and after the close. No holiday list yet.

hkex.note: Observed for ZHIPU and MINIMAX: external 09:30-12:00 and 13:00-16:00 Hong Kong time. SHEIN showed the same open and close. No holiday list yet.
